summary: Champaign-Urbana, Illinois, software engineer, former high-ranking engineer at Apple, parallel computing expertise, strong criticism of groupthink in tech culture, interest in programming languages (Python, Go, Swift), advocate for ethical treatment of animals, vegetarian, owns three rescue cats and a lab mix dog, skeptical of mainstream media bias, particularly against Apple, engaged in discussions about political and social issues, interest in plant-based diets and environmental concerns.
